transport_notes: 2026-10-26: Initial raw downloads via statsbomb alias hit TLS EOF; curl reset and Contents API quota0. Repository now redirects to official hudl/open-data; canonical raw owner probe succeeded, so plan uses hudl. No token or credentials used; existing files are retained.

infactory_soccer_events.title: Infactory Soccer Events
infactory_soccer_events.license: Proprietary Infront Italy content; dataset author permits non-commercial research only; not permission to redistribute broadcasts.
infactory_soccer_events.annotation_quality: Provider multimodal automatic labels; human review required
infactory_soccer_events.not_covered: Not latest 2026 footage, precise offside/goal-line truth, foul correctness, recipient identity, or all 42 events.

wikimedia_commons.title: Wikimedia Commons: two CC0 football photographs
wikimedia_commons.license: CC0-1.0 per authors' declarations on the two linked Commons file pages; photographs have no supplied boxes or adjudication truth.
wikimedia_commons.not_covered: Only source-captioned save and free-kick preparation images; not professional VAR truth, no direct/indirect classification or event outcome labels.

statsbomb_open_data.title: StatsBomb Open Data
statsbomb_open_data.license: StatsBomb Public Data User Agreement; non-commercial research/analytics only; do not redistribute raw data; publication of analysis requires StatsBomb attribution and brand logo. See downloaded LICENSE.pdf for full terms.
statsbomb_open_data.not_covered: Event JSON is not image/video or YOLO boxes; goal/card/free-kick/location mappings may be partial.
